unslop-backend

English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Türkçe · Español · Français · Deutsch · Português · Tiếng Việt · Русский

Stop vibecoded backends from shipping 200-query N+1 loops and full table scans.
An agent skill that profiles, fixes, and proves SQL, ORM, and API speedups with paired benchmarks and exact golden SHA-256 parity.

Install · Use · Proof · Case Study · What It Catches · How It Works · Limits · Status

Coding agents build working endpoints fast, and local tests usually seed five rows. A 214-query N+1 cascade, an unindexed join table, or an in-memory `SELECT *` aggregation looks instant on a laptop until real traffic hits. Asking an agent to "optimize this" makes one unmeasured guess, ships placebo rewrites, or silently breaks sort order and nullable fields. **unslop-backend** measures first in your existing stack (Node/TypeScript, Python, Go, Ruby, SQL). It records baseline query counts, rows scanned, `EXPLAIN` plans, p95 latency, and a canonical `golden_sha256` at realistic local scale (`>= 1,000` rows), fixes one bottleneck at a time (or stays strictly read-only in Audit mode), and hard-fails any patch whose output drifts or whose speedup fails to clear the noise floor.
Map
scan-slop.cjs and 4 parallel research passes map routes, ORM calls, schema indexes, and exports into a validated workload-ledger.json. 		Baseline
Seeds >= 1,000 local rows, warms pools, and records queries_per_req, rows_scanned, EXPLAIN, p95_ms, and golden_sha256. 		Unslop
Applies one minimal fix per unit across 8 backend slop classes (or writes a read-only audit report) plus a regression guard test. 		Prove
compare-benchmarks.cjs and a Fresh Skeptic pass verify parity. SHA-256 drift, cache_mode mismatch, or sub-noise gains exit 1.


Measured locally on real on-disk node:sqlite with zero mocks. Reproduce in 2 seconds via npm run test:benchmarks.

--- ## Install Requires only your local coding agent and Node.js `>= 22.5` (zero runtime npm dependencies): ```bash # Universal Skills CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, OpenCode) npx skills add https://github.com/Treamyracle/unslop-backend --skill unslop-backend # Or install globally across projects npx skills add https://github.com/Treamyracle/unslop-backend --skill unslop-backend --global ```
Native Plugin, Extension & Standalone CLI Installs (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity) ```bash # Claude Code marketplace install (.claude-plugin/) claude plugin install unslop-backend --marketplace Treamyracle/unslop-backend # Gemini CLI extension (gemini-extension.json) gemini extensions install https://github.com/Treamyracle/unslop-backend # Google Antigravity / Cursor / Codex / Open Agents git clone https://github.com/Treamyracle/unslop-backend.git cp -r unslop-backend/skills/unslop-backend ~/.agents/skills/ # Standalone static pre-scanner directly on any backend folder (no plugin install needed): node unslop-backend/skills/unslop-backend/scan-slop.cjs ./src --json ```
--- ## Use Ask in plain English; the matching mode engages automatically: | Say | Mode | What happens | |---|---|---| | `"Check whether our Prisma/SQLAlchemy orders repo is doing in-app aggregation"` | **Guidance** | Read-only Q&A grounded in the 6 stack playbooks; edits nothing. | | `"Audit ./src for N+1 queries, missing indexes, SELECT * bloat, and async waterfalls"` | **Audit** | Runs full 6-phase read-only reconnaissance, baseline measurement, and writes `REPORT.md`; edits zero source files. | | `"Measure baseline query counts and unslop ./src/api without changing API output"` | **Unslop** | Applies branch-isolated fixes gated on paired `baseline.json` vs `after.json`, `golden_sha256`, regression guard tests, and Fresh Skeptic review. | --- ## Proof, not vibes Most performance prompts stop as soon as the edited code still compiles. `unslop-backend` locks every optimization behind deterministic Node CLI gates (`exit 1` on any violation). Here is real output from [`compare-benchmarks.cjs`](skills/unslop-backend/compare-benchmarks.cjs) on the [`louislam/uptime-kuma`](examples/case-studies/uptime-kuma/README.md) reproduction: ```text Paired Benchmark Gate: **PASS** (`cache_mode=warm`, `dataset_rows=25000`) | Workload | Queries (Before → After) | Rows Scanned | Internal / Payload Bytes | p95 Latency | Golden Parity | Gate | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---| | `uptime-kuma-status-page-data` | 214 → 7 (-96.7%) | 315554 → 915 (-99.7%) | 374202B int → 185814B int (-50.3%) | 50.70ms → 3.67ms (-92.8%) | MATCH (SHA-256) | PASS | | `uptime-kuma-rss-page-data` | 314 → 8 (-97.5%) | 315654 → 1115 (-99.7%) | 385352B int → 192107B int (-50.1%) | 54.82ms → 3.44ms (-93.7%) | MATCH (SHA-256) | PASS | ``` ### How the deterministic gates stop an agent from cheating | Failure Condition | What the Gate Catches | Enforcement | |---|---|---| | **Output contract drift** | Dropped nullable keys, shifted sort tie-breakers, changed aggregate precision, or reordered export IDs (`golden_sha256 DRIFT` / `row_ids_sha256`) | [`compare-benchmarks.cjs`](skills/unslop-backend/compare-benchmarks.cjs) exits `1` | | **Unfair before/after pairing** | Cold baseline vs warm after (`cache_mode` mismatch) or fewer seeded rows after the edit (`dataset_rows` mismatch) | [`compare-benchmarks.cjs`](skills/unslop-backend/compare-benchmarks.cjs) exits `1` | | **Placebo speedup or hidden regression** | Failing to clear the noise floor (`>= 50%` query/scan drop, `>= 30%` payload/heap drop, or `>= 20%` p95 drop) or regressing any counter `> 15%` | [`compare-benchmarks.cjs`](skills/unslop-backend/compare-benchmarks.cjs) exits `1` | | **Speculative or hallucinated line cites** | Out-of-bounds `source_trace` lines, missing ledger unit coverage (`--require-complete`), or non-null severity on an unexecuted lead | [`validate-findings.cjs`](skills/unslop-backend/validate-findings.cjs) exits `1` (enforces `needs_validation` + `severity: null`) | --- ## Real Open-Source Case Study: `louislam/uptime-kuma` (`94.8k★`) To verify `unslop-backend` on real production open-source code rather than toy examples alone, we audited [`louislam/uptime-kuma`](https://github.com/louislam/uptime-kuma) at commit [`1cc2fa7`](https://github.com/louislam/uptime-kuma/tree/1cc2fa7b1c9ec2be8e610167c8208309283177f2) and built a zero-dependency real SQLite (`node:sqlite`) reproduction using its exact upstream schema (`db/knex_init_db.js`) and exact SQL queries (`server/model/status_page.js`, `group.js`, `monitor.js`). - **What `unslop-backend` found:** A **3-level nested SQL N+1 cascade** (`getStatusPageData` → `Group.getMonitorList` → `Monitor.getTags` & `Monitor.getCertExpiry`, plus `getRSSPageData` heartbeat loop) where `monitor_tag(monitor_id)` and `monitor_tls_info(monitor_id)` had **zero indexes**, forcing full table scans (`SCAN mt`, `SCAN monitor_tls_info`) for every monitor while `SELECT monitor.*` overfetched wide config columns. - **Reproduce locally on real on-disk SQLite in 2 seconds:** ```bash node examples/case-studies/uptime-kuma/reproduce.cjs ``` | Upstream Workload (`10` groups, `100` monitors, `25,000` heartbeats) | Queries (Before → After) | Rows Examined | Uninstrumented p95 | Golden Parity | |---|---:|---:|---:|---| | [`StatusPage.getStatusPageData`](examples/case-studies/uptime-kuma/README.md) | `214 → 7 (-96.7%)` | `315,554 → 915 (-99.7%)` | `50.70 ms → 3.67 ms (-92.8%)` | `MATCH (SHA-256)` | | [`StatusPage.getRSSPageData`](examples/case-studies/uptime-kuma/README.md) | `314 → 8 (-97.5%)` | `315,654 → 1,115 (-99.7%)` | `54.82 ms → 3.44 ms (-93.7%)` | `MATCH (SHA-256)` | ```diff # Actual SQLite EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN transition (StatusPage.getStatusPageData + getRSSPageData) - SCAN incident / SCAN maintenance_status_page / SCAN group / SCAN monitor_group / SCAN mt (x100) / SCAN monitor_tls_info (x100) / USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY + SEARCH incident USING INDEX idx_incident_status_pin_active + SEARCH maintenance_status_page USING COVERING INDEX idx_maintenance_sp + SEARCH group USING INDEX idx_group_status_page_public_weight + SEARCH mg USING INDEX idx_monitor_group_group_weight + SEARCH mt USING INDEX idx_monitor_tag_monitor (batched WHERE IN) + SEARCH monitor_tls_info USING INDEX idx_monitor_tls_info_monitor + SEARCH h2 USING COVERING INDEX monitor_time_index (correlated single-seek per monitor) ``` > **Scope & timing honesty:** Upstream [`status-page-router.js`](https://github.com/louislam/uptime-kuma/blob/1cc2fa7b1c9ec2be8e610167c8208309283177f2/server/routers/status-page-router.js#L16-L60) wraps these routes in 5-minute `apicache`, so this 214/314-query cascade fires on cache misses, cold starts, and post-edit invalidation (on fresh v2 schemas built by `db/knex_init_db.js`). Wall-clock p95 is timed on an uninstrumented pass completely separated from `EXPLAIN`, serialization byte-counting, and `stmt.stat("fullscanStep")` / `rowid` scan capture. Full breakdown: [`examples/case-studies/uptime-kuma/README.md`](examples/case-studies/uptime-kuma/README.md). --- ## What It Catches Every finding and unit coverage check maps to one of the 8 canonical classes in [`SLOP-CLASSES.md`](skills/unslop-backend/SLOP-CLASSES.md): | Slop Class | Pattern in Vibecoded Backends | Measured Signal | |---|---|---| | `n_plus_one_cascade` | ORM lazy-loads, `findOne`, or internal RPCs inside `for` / `.map()` loops | `queries_per_req` scales `O(N)` with list size | | `missing_or_broken_index` | Missing composite indexes, wrong leading columns, `LOWER(col)` predicates, deep `OFFSET` | `EXPLAIN` shows `Seq Scan` / `SCAN` with `rows_scanned >> rows_returned` | | `overfetch_and_payload_bloat` | `SELECT *` / unbounded `.findMany()` pulling wide JSON/TEXT columns only to discard them | Spiking `internal_bytes_read` or HTTP `payload_bytes` | | `in_app_aggregation` | Pulling thousands of rows into JS/Python/Go memory to `.filter()`, `.sort()`, `.length`, or `reduce` | `rows_scanned` scales with full table size for small KPI/top-K output | | `async_waterfall` | Sequential `await` chains across independent DB/HTTP/disk calls or duplicate per-request reads | `p95_ms` tracks sum of I/O legs instead of `max(...)` | | `connection_and_tx_bloat` | Per-request DB/HTTP clients instead of pools, or holding SQL transactions open across LLM/HTTP I/O | Handshake spikes or long `idle in transaction` stalls | | `memory_and_stream_slop` | Buffering multi-MB exports in RAM, `JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(...))` in loops, `readFileSync` on hot paths | High `heap_delta_kb`, event-loop pauses, unbounded RSS growth | | `cold_start_and_bundle_slop` | Monolithic SDK barrel imports or eager client initialization at serverless/CLI module top level | Elevated cold-start `p95_ms` (`cache_mode: "cold"`) before first byte | --- ## How It Works

1. **Reconnaissance & Pre-Scan ([`RECONNAISSANCE.md`](skills/unslop-backend/RECONNAISSANCE.md)):** Optionally seed candidate leads with [`scan-slop.cjs`](skills/unslop-backend/scan-slop.cjs), then run 4 parallel `research` agents across entrypoints, schemas/indexes, background exports/AI loops, and local profiling hooks to build `architecture.md` and `workload-ledger.json` (validated via [`validate-workload-ledger.cjs`](skills/unslop-backend/validate-workload-ledger.cjs)). 2. **Baseline & Golden Capture ([`BASELINE-AND-GOLDEN.md`](skills/unslop-backend/BASELINE-AND-GOLDEN.md)):** Seed `>= 1,000` deterministic local rows, warm up pools, record `baseline.json`, and lock canonical `golden_sha256` snapshots. 3. **Coverage-Led Hunting ([`HUNTING.md`](skills/unslop-backend/HUNTING.md)):** Audit every unit across all 8 classes in [`SLOP-CLASSES.md`](skills/unslop-backend/SLOP-CLASSES.md) and pass a Coverage Critic check (`validate-workload-ledger.cjs --require-complete`). 4. **Prove or Unslop ([`VALIDATION-AND-REPORTING.md`](skills/unslop-backend/VALIDATION-AND-REPORTING.md)):** Audit mode records read-only evidence; Unslop mode applies one minimal behavior-preserving fix per surface on a working branch, adds a regression guard test, captures `after.json`, and enforces [`compare-benchmarks.cjs`](skills/unslop-backend/compare-benchmarks.cjs). 5. **Fresh Skeptic Verification:** An independent skeptic probes tie-breakers, `NULL`/soft-delete semantics, cross-tenant cache isolation, and index write amplification before [`validate-findings.cjs`](skills/unslop-backend/validate-findings.cjs) signs off `findings.json`. 6. **Target-Neutral Reports:** Emits `REPORT.md`, `BENCHMARKS.md`, `FINDINGS-DETAIL.md`, and `NEEDS-VALIDATION.md`. ### Strict Four-Verdict Contract - **`fixed`** *(Unslop mode only)*: Paired `baseline` + `after` benchmarks pass [`compare-benchmarks.cjs`](skills/unslop-backend/compare-benchmarks.cjs), `golden_match: true`, `skeptic_attempted: true`, and regression guard test passes. - **`confirmed`**: Source trace + executed baseline telemetry/plan proving the slop without modifying source (`skeptic_attempted: true`). - **`needs_validation`**: Plausible slop path where local DB/benchmark execution was blocked — **`severity` forced to `null`**, paired with a `safe_verification_recipe`. - **`rejected`**: Disproved lead or rejected rewrite (already bounded or write tax outweighs scan cost) with `severity: null`.
Sample Verified fixed Finding (examples/sample-audit-output/findings.json) ```json { "finding_id": "UNSLOP-001", "unit_id": "orders-list", "slop_class": "n_plus_one_cascade", "verdict": "fixed", "severity": "critical", "title": "Eliminated 101-query SQLite N+1 cascade and 755k-row full scans on GET /api/orgs/:orgId/orders", "baseline_metrics": { "queries_per_req": 101, "rows_scanned": 755050, "internal_bytes_read": 178205, "p95_ms": 93.454 }, "after_metrics": { "queries_per_req": 3, "rows_scanned": 220, "internal_bytes_read": 12946, "p95_ms": 2.788 }, "golden_match": true, "skeptic_attempted": true, "regression_guard_test": "node --test examples/sloppy-saas-api/benchmarks/slop-proof.bench.test.cjs" } ``` Inspect the full validated sample artifacts: [`REPORT.md`](examples/sample-audit-output/REPORT.md) · [`BENCHMARKS.md`](examples/sample-audit-output/BENCHMARKS.md) · [`FINDINGS-DETAIL.md`](examples/sample-audit-output/FINDINGS-DETAIL.md) · [`NEEDS-VALIDATION.md`](examples/sample-audit-output/NEEDS-VALIDATION.md).

Full breakdown: [`examples/case-studies/uptime-kuma/README.md`](examples/case-studies/uptime-kuma/README.md). --- ## What It Catches Every finding and unit coverage check maps to one of the 8 canonical classes in [`SLOP-CLASSES.md`](skills/unslop-backend/SLOP-CLASSES.md): | Slop Class | Pattern in Vibecoded Backends | Measured Signal | |---|---|---| | `n_plus_one_cascade` | ORM lazy-loads, `findOne`, or internal RPCs inside `for` / `.map()` loops | `queries_per_req` scales `O(N)` with list size | | `missing_or_broken_index` | Missing composite indexes, wrong leading columns, `LOWER(col)` predicates, deep `OFFSET` | `EXPLAIN` shows `Seq Scan` / `SCAN` with `rows_scanned >> rows_returned` | | `overfetch_and_payload_bloat` | `SELECT *` / unbounded `.findMany()` pulling wide JSON/TEXT columns only to discard them | Spiking `internal_bytes_read` or HTTP `payload_bytes` | | `in_app_aggregation` | Pulling thousands of rows into JS/Python/Go memory to `.filter()`, `.sort()`, `.length`, or `reduce` | `rows_scanned` scales with full table size for small KPI/top-K output | | `async_waterfall` | Sequential `await` chains across independent DB/HTTP/disk calls or duplicate per-request reads | `p95_ms` tracks sum of I/O legs instead of `max(...)` | | `connection_and_tx_bloat` | Per-request DB/HTTP clients instead of pools, or holding SQL transactions open across LLM/HTTP I/O | Handshake spikes or long `idle in transaction` stalls | | `memory_and_stream_slop` | Buffering multi-MB exports in RAM, `JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(...))` in loops, `readFileSync` on hot paths | High `heap_delta_kb`, event-loop pauses, unbounded RSS growth | | `cold_start_and_bundle_slop` | Monolithic SDK barrel imports or eager client initialization at serverless/CLI module top level | Elevated cold-start `p95_ms` (`cache_mode: "cold"`) before first byte | --- ## How It Works

1. **Reconnaissance & Pre-Scan ([`RECONNAISSANCE.md`](skills/unslop-backend/RECONNAISSANCE.md)):** Optionally seed candidate leads with [`scan-slop.cjs`](skills/unslop-backend/scan-slop.cjs), then run 4 parallel `research` agents across entrypoints, schemas/indexes, background exports/AI loops, and local profiling hooks to build `architecture.md` and `workload-ledger.json` (validated via [`validate-workload-ledger.cjs`](skills/unslop-backend/validate-workload-ledger.cjs)). 2. **Baseline & Golden Capture ([`BASELINE-AND-GOLDEN.md`](skills/unslop-backend/BASELINE-AND-GOLDEN.md)):** Seed `>= 1,000` deterministic local rows, warm up pools, record `baseline.json`, and lock canonical `golden_sha256` snapshots. 3. **Coverage-Led Hunting ([`HUNTING.md`](skills/unslop-backend/HUNTING.md)):** Audit every unit across all 8 classes in [`SLOP-CLASSES.md`](skills/unslop-backend/SLOP-CLASSES.md) and pass a Coverage Critic check (`validate-workload-ledger.cjs --require-complete`). 4. **Prove or Unslop ([`VALIDATION-AND-REPORTING.md`](skills/unslop-backend/VALIDATION-AND-REPORTING.md)):** Audit mode records read-only evidence; Unslop mode applies one minimal behavior-preserving fix per surface on a working branch, adds a regression guard test, captures `after.json`, and enforces [`compare-benchmarks.cjs`](skills/unslop-backend/compare-benchmarks.cjs). 5. **Fresh Skeptic Verification:** An independent skeptic probes tie-breakers, `NULL`/soft-delete semantics, cross-tenant cache isolation, and index write amplification before [`validate-findings.cjs`](skills/unslop-backend/validate-findings.cjs) signs off `findings.json`. 6. **Target-Neutral Reports:** Emits `REPORT.md`, `BENCHMARKS.md`, `FINDINGS-DETAIL.md`, and `NEEDS-VALIDATION.md`. ### Strict Four-Verdict Contract - **`fixed`** *(Unslop mode only)*: Paired `baseline` + `after` benchmarks pass [`compare-benchmarks.cjs`](skills/unslop-backend/compare-benchmarks.cjs), `golden_match: true`, `skeptic_attempted: true`, and regression guard test passes. - **`confirmed`**: Source trace + executed baseline telemetry/plan proving the slop without modifying source (`skeptic_attempted: true`). - **`needs_validation`**: Plausible slop path where local DB/benchmark execution was blocked — **`severity` forced to `null`**, paired with a `safe_verification_recipe`. - **`rejected`**: Disproved lead or rejected rewrite (already bounded or write tax outweighs scan cost) with `severity: null`.
